data.name: No Final Night: Protect The Sponk Can
data.detailed_description:
THE LAST SPONK ENERGY CAN IN THE WORLD

You are the night guard at your local copper factory. Boring job, dead end town, nothing ever happens... except your factory is sitting on the LAST Sponk Energy can left on Earth.

And three Sponk addicted junkies want it BAD.

SURVIVE FROM 12 AM TO 6 AM

Every night, Motan, Grigore and Foca will do whatever it takes to break into your office, get their hands on that can, and leave you with nothing. You get a tiny office, two doors, some lights, a wall of security cameras, and a battery that is absolutely NOT your friend, that btw its an UPS from nJOY xD. Everything you do drains power, and when the power dies... you are not alone for long.

  • Watch the cameras - track the junkies room by room. The cameras won't tell you who's where. You have to look, and you have to listen.

  • Slam the doors - a closed door keeps them out, but it eats your power fast.

  • Flick the lights - peek into the doorways to catch someone standing right next to you.

  • Manage your power - you start every night at 100%. Doors, lights and cameras all drain it. Hit 0% and it's over.

Every one of them hunts differently. Grigore comes down the left. Foca comes down the right. And Motan? Motan does NOT wait his turn , take your eyes off him for too long and he sprints straight for your door, because he is a sneaky bastard hunter and your worst nightmare that ever existed.

THERE IS NO FINAL NIGHT

Every night is 5% harder than the last. The junkies get faster, thirstier and smarter, and the game never stops throwing nights at you. No ending. No victory screen. No "you won." There is only the next night.

So how long can you last? :3

FEATURING

  • Endless, escalating survival horror - every night is harder than the last

  • Three relentless enemies, each with their own way of hunting you down

  • Loud jumpscares and intense strobe and flashing effects (you have been warned!!!)

  • Full controller support, built and optimized for Steam Deck (some additional button mapping required, see in game controls for more informations i.e r4, l4, r5, l5)

  • An unhealthy amount of Sponk Energy drinks

Watch the cameras, slam the doors and burn your power wisely to survive from 12 AM to 6 AM. Every night is harder than the last. There is no final night.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-650 / Any 64bit cpu that runs Win10 64-Bit
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any gpu that has supported drivers. 256MB VRAM for decent user experience in OS and game.
  • Storage: 569 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Can you hear any sounds from it? If yes, you can play this game.
  • Additional Notes: This games can run on any modern machine (last 15 years, that has a working OS).
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 11 64bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i7 4790k / Any 64bit cpu that runs Win11 64-Bit
  • Memory: 6 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Any gpu that has supported drivers. 256MB VRAM for decent user experience in OS and game.
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Can you hear any sounds from it? If yes, you can play this game.
  • Additional Notes: This games can run on any modern machine (last 15 years, that has a working OS).

content_descriptors.notes:
No Final Night is a comedic horror survival game, it contains very frequent strong profanity, frequent crude 
and adult hummor including sexual innuendo and sex related language (there is no nudity and no depicated sexual content). 

Horror themes with load jumpscares and intense flashing and strobe effect, and comedic references to 
substance addiction. 

All characters are fictional adults or fantasy creatures. All characters have full consent
to be used for making the game. 

The game is single player and complety offline, with no purchases, no chat features and no online features. 

No Final Night resolves around a "Sponk Energy", that is purely a fictional energy drinkl that was created for this specific game using developers edgy inside jokes.
